title: Dupilumab in Major Depressive Disorder
official: Target Validation of Interleukin-4 Receptor Alpha for Major Depressive Disorder
summary: This study aims primarily to test target engagement of dupilumab by assessing changes in peripheral immune markers following interleukin-4 receptor alpha (IL-4Rα) blockade in adults with major depressive disorder (MDD). Secondary aims include evaluating safety, tolerability, feasibility, and open-label effects on depressive symptoms, blood-based immune markers, blood-brain barrier (BBB) function, and functional brain reward circuitry.
sponsor: Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai

sites.f: The Dennis S. Charney, MD, Depression and Anxiety Discovery Center
